services.name: CrossFit brio
services.desc: Work Of the Day. This is the workout that appears every morning on our blog and on the whiteboard at the gym. It's the workout we are doing in each class, all day long. As Many Rounds As Possible. This is a workout format where we're trying to do as much work as possible in a defined amount of time. Rounds For Time.This is a workout format where we're trying to do a defined amount of work as fast as possible. On The Minute or Every Minute On the Minute. This is a workout format where we're doing a set amount of work starting every minute and remaining time is rest. This is used largely for strength or skill
